author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices counting repeated notes, steps and leaps, question-and-answer lines and soft playing, using a song about whispering a Christmas wish.

classes.title: Santa's five-key chimney
classes.goal: Hear the song, find C by the two black keys and place five fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a sign to find C

classes.parentPrompt: Point to two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C, fingers beside it.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, then one finger on each key up to G.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are the chimney top; C is the door just left.

intro.caption: Find the two black keys
intro.parentCue: point to them; C is just to the left

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger number for each key

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C and placing five fingers.

classes.title: Four, then three
classes.goal: Learn the first line and count the notes: four Es, then three Ds.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting a group of notes: four of these, three of those

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up four fingers for the Es and three for the Ds, counting aloud.
classes.childAction: Play E four times, then D three times. Count as you go.
classes.bridge: Jol-ly old Saint: four knocks on E; Ni-cho-las: three on D.

intro.caption: Count the knocks on Santa's door
intro.parentCue: hold up fingers as you count together

games.caption: Lean your ear this way
games.parentCue: Count four Cs, then hold the E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting groups of four and three.

classes.title: A little step, a big jump
classes.goal: Learn the next line and feel the jump from D up to G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Some notes are neighbours; some jump over keys

classes.parentPrompt: Count the keys your child jumps over together. You play the high A part yourself.
classes.childAction: Play four Ds, then jump finger five up to G.
classes.bridge: D to E is a tiny step; D to G is a leap over two keys.

intro.caption: Four Ds, then a big jump
intro.parentCue: you play the high A part that follows

games.caption: Don't you tell a single soul
games.parentCue: Say 'jump!' as finger five lands on G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing small steps and big jumps.

classes.title: Same tune, new words
classes.goal: Learn the second half and find that its tune repeats the first half.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tune comes back with new words and a new ending

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the new words over the old tune. You play the high A at the end.
classes.childAction: Play the tune again with new words, then walk home to C.
classes.bridge: Christmas Eve uses the same keys as Saint Nicholas; only the words change.

intro.caption: Does this tune sound familiar?
intro.parentCue: sing the new words and let your child guess

games.caption: Tell me if you can
games.parentCue: Play the A first, then your child answers

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: noticing a tune that repeats with new words.

classes.title: A question and an answer
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hear the first half ask, the second half answer.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first half ends up in the air; the second lands home

classes.parentPrompt: At the middle, shrug and ask 'Is it finished?' At the end, nod: 'Now it is!'
classes.childAction: Play the song slowly; shrug at the middle, nod at the end.
classes.bridge: The first half stops on D, a question; the last note C is home.

intro.caption: Is the song finished yet?
intro.parentCue: ask at the middle and at the end

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a song ask and answer.

classes.title: Quiet hand, jumping finger
classes.goal: Practise the jump from D to G slowly, keeping the whole hand still.

mathTarget.parentLine: The hand stays still; only the fingers take turns

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand lightly on the back of your child's hand so it stays still.
classes.childAction: Keep your hand still; finger two, then finger five.
classes.bridge: The hand is a sleeping cat; only its toes wake up to play.

intro.caption: A sleepy hand, busy fingers
intro.parentCue: rest your hand lightly on top of theirs

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping the hand still while fingers move.

classes.title: Whisper it to Santa
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, softly and evenly, like telling a secret.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing softly and evenly, like a quiet whisper

classes.parentPrompt: Whisper 'shh' before you start and pat a slow beat on your child's back.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and softly, like whispering a secret.
classes.bridge: Soft fingers are a whisper in Santa's ear; even notes keep the secret.

intro.caption: Shh, it's a secret
intro.parentCue: whisper first, then pat a slow beat

games.caption: Tap and count to four
games.parentCue: Count softly as your child taps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly, softly and evenly.

classes.title: Sleigh ride play-along
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the words softly beside your child; if they miss a note, keep singing.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep going after a slip.
classes.bridge: The music is the sleigh; your fingers ride along, never jumping off.

intro.caption: Hop on the sleigh!
intro.parentCue: sing softly beside your child and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: A Christmas wish concert
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and whisper a wish at the very end.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and lands home at the end

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play together, whisper a wish, then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, whisper a wish, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The last long C is the chimney: the wish goes home.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song together, start to end.
